MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The wired earbuds fit my use of headphones with a laptop and give me a compact option for listening and calls.",
    "The SanDisk microSD card connects to my previous microSD purchases and Raspberry Pi kit, giving me a plausible storage expansion after checking compatibility."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices and Fire TV sticks don't help with the computer connections, desk organization, and maintenance I've recently been working on.",
    "A full-size SD card doesn't serve the same immediate purpose as microSD storage, and another HDMI cable needs a specific length or connection need to be useful.",
    "The tablet and TV mount assume new activities I haven't shown a need for; my Kindle covers reading, and I have no TV mounting project."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as interest in smart speakers, streaming devices, and tablets generally.",
    "My cable and memory-card purchases seem to have been taken as reasons to buy more of either, without enough attention to their particular uses."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases work together around a computer setup: wired networking, carrying my laptop, keeping headphones accessible, and cleaning equipment.",
    "The connector, card format, and compatibility matter to me because an accessory has to work with equipment I already own.",
    "Buying an accessory can mean that need is already covered; I need a concrete reason for a replacement or upgrade."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognized my audio and storage needs but stretched my practical computer-accessory interests into unrelated electronics purchases."
}
